svg.title: Final and peak outbreak size scale as one over one plus the lockdown factor
svg.desc: Panel a: cumulative infections as a percentage of population against the lockdown rate factor psi on log axes. A line shows the paper's closed-form relation at the U.S. median reproduction number. For each of 55 state and territorial jurisdictions, an open marker shows the closed form at its published reproduction number and psi, and a filled marker joined by a vertical segment shows the model solved over 400 days from its published initial infections with its published fatigue rate; the filled marker is never below the open one. Triangles identify fatigue half-lives under 15 days. Panel b: the same for peak outbreak size, the maximum of I over N.
